theorem helper_2_3_step2 (a b c d e f : Point) (AB CD BE DE AF : Line)
    (hbetween : between a c b)
    (ha_AB : a.onLine AB) (hb_AB : b.onLine AB) (hc_AB : c.onLine AB)
    (hc_CD : c.onLine CD) (hd_CD : d.onLine CD)
    (hd_DE : d.onLine DE) (he_DE : e.onLine DE)
    (hb_BE : b.onLine BE) (he_BE : e.onLine BE)
    (ha_AF : a.onLine AF) (hf_AF : f.onLine AF) (hf_DE : f.onLine DE)
    (h_CD_BE : ¬CD.intersectsLine BE)
    (h_AF_CD : ¬AF.intersectsLine CD)
    (h_cde : ∠ c:d:e = ∟)
    (h_ab : a ≠ b) (h_eb : e ≠ b) :
    f.onLine DE ∧ between e d f := by
  refine ⟨hf_DE, ?_⟩
  -- a and b are on opposite sides of CD (line CD crosses AB at c, with between a c b)
  have hab : a.opposingSides b CD := by euclid_finish
  -- b and e on the same side of CD (BE is parallel to CD)
  have hbe : b.sameSide e CD := by euclid_finish
  -- a and f on the same side of CD (AF is parallel to CD)
  have haf : a.sameSide f CD := by euclid_finish
  -- hence e and f are on opposite sides of CD
  have hef : ¬(e.sameSide f CD) := by euclid_finish
  -- D lies on CD and on DE, so D is between E and F on line DE (pasch_4)
  euclid_apply (pasch_4 e d f CD DE)
  euclid_finish
